title: Shift Dynamics on Cantor Space: Toward Furstenberg Correspondence

problemStatement.formal: Define shift T on \Omega = \{0,1\}^\mathbb{N}, prove T continuous/measurable, build cylinder sets, prove k-fold return property connecting T^{-id}(B_0) intersections to k-APs in A
problemStatement.plain: Build the shift dynamical system on Cantor space needed for the Furstenberg correspondence principle. All results proved from Mathlib with 0 axioms.
